raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx942 with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `aiter_w8a8_block_fp8_linear` runs every dense block-FP8 linear on the AITER Triton blockscale GEMM; the CK blockscale GEMM it already imports is never used there, while vLLM sends gfx942 to CK. CK is much faster on gfx942 but lowers accuracy on Qwen3-32B-FP8 (below), so this PR adds it behind an opt-in flag instead of changing the default. It revives #26234, which was closed as stale without a review.

## Modifications

- `SGLANG_AITER_GFX942_BLOCKSCALE_USE_CK` (default `false`): on gfx942, run dense block-FP8 linears with the AITER CK blockscale GEMM. The default path and other devices are unchanged.
- `environ.py` and `environment_variables.mdx` add the flag.

## Accuracy Tests

8x MI300X (gfx942), ROCm 7.2.2, torch 2.10, AITER at the Docker pin (`e7d2453f`), main at `23f89061` with this PR; `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --context-length 16384 --chunked-prefill-size 16384`. One model per GPU (122B at TP 2); the default and CK arms ran as two back-to-back phases under the same load.

GSM8K (`sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 5-shot, 1319 questions, greedy):

| model | default (Triton) | CK |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-8B-FP8 | 0.893 | 0.889 |
| Qwen3-14B-FP8 | 0.880 | 0.877 |
| Qwen3-32B-FP8 (mean of 3 runs) | 0.832 | 0.809 |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 | 0.853 | 0.869 |
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 | 0.939 | 0.942 |
| Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 | 0.960 | 0.957 |

Qwen3-32B-FP8 loses about 2 points with CK: 0.807–0.813 against 0.828–0.839 over three runs each, and 0.754–0.764 against 0.788–0.810 at temperature 0.6. Sending only its `o_proj` (N=5120, K=8192) back to Triton restores it, yet that GEMM's CK output matches Triton to bf16 rounding on every call we checked, including 54k calls inside the server. We could not find the cause, so CK stays opt-in.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`sglang.benchmark.serving --dataset-name random-ids`, output tok/s, default → CK:

| model | 64 × (1024 in, 512 out), conc 4 | 384 × (8192 in, 1024 out), conc 128 |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-8B-FP8 | 445 → 508 (+14%) | 1338 → 1369 (+2%) |
| Qwen3-14B-FP8 | 103 → 388 (+277%) | 641 → 829 (+29%) |
| Qwen3-32B-FP8 | 42 → 173 (+314%) | 225 → 337 (+50%) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 | 275 → 633 (+130%) | 1741 → 2142 (+23%) |
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 | 255 → 524 (+106%) | 1934 → 2319 (+20%) |
| Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 | 228 → 493 (+116%) | 1476 → 1726 (+17%) |

Median TTFT drops for every model at conc 128, and for all but Qwen3-32B (892 → 910 ms) at conc 4. Qwen3-8B gains least because all four of its linear shapes have a gfx942-tuned Triton config in AITER, while most Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B shapes fall back to Triton's default config.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom) while optimizing `Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8`; reviewed and measured by hand.

Skipping the reserve can OOM long-context serving; set it only when the scaled fraction is too small to hold the model weights. false + + SGLANG_AITER_GFX942_BLOCKSCALE_USE_CK + On gfx942, run dense block-FP8 linears with the AITER CK blockscale GEMM instead of the AITER Triton one. Faster, especially at decode batch sizes, but check accuracy: it lowers GSM8K on Qwen3-32B-FP8 by about 2 points. + false + SGLANG_USE_AITER_MOE_GU_ITLV Select the AITER MoE gate/up tile layout: true interleaves, false uses the separated layout.

@@ -978,6 +978,8 @@ class Envs:
     SGLANG_AITER_MLA_VERIFY_BACKEND = EnvStr("asm")
     # Let aiter plan the KV splits for the asm persistent MLA decode.
     SGLANG_AITER_MLA_AUTO_KV_SPLITS = EnvBool(False)
+    # Run gfx942 block-FP8 linears with the AITER CK blockscale GEMM instead of Triton.
+    SGLANG_AITER_GFX942_BLOCKSCALE_USE_CK = EnvBool(False)
 
     # DSV4 Aiter flags
     SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_SILU_MUL = EnvBool(False)

@@ -45,6 +45,7 @@
     is_cuda,
     is_flashinfer_available,
     is_gfx95_supported,
+    is_gfx942_supported,
     is_gfx1250_supported,
     is_hip,
     is_musa,
@@ -74,6 +75,7 @@
     get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_USE_AITER") and _is_hip and not _is_gfx1250_supported
 )
 _use_aiter_gfx95 = _use_aiter and _is_gfx95_supported
+_use_aiter_gfx942 = _use_aiter and is_gfx942_supported()
 # Conservative, not a tuned crossover: ptpc beat block-fp8 up to M=512 on
 # MiniMax-M3 TP4 gfx950 shapes, but lost past M=64 on narrow ones (K=768).
 MXFP8_DENSE_PTPC_DECODE_MAX_M = 128
@@ -1420,6 +1422,8 @@ def aiter_w8a8_block_fp8_linear(
         use_triton = use_aiter_triton_gemm_w8a8_tuned_gfx950(n, k) or (
             _ck_safe_m is not None and input_2d.shape[0] > _ck_safe_m
         )
+    elif _use_aiter_gfx942:
+        use_triton = not envs.SGLANG_AITER_GFX942_BLOCKSCALE_USE_CK.get()
     else:
         use_triton = True
